svg.title: Trait-group honesty rates across phases in Experiments 3a and 3b — Figure 8
svg.desc: Original published Figure 8, page 391, Wang et al. (2026), DOI 10.3724/SP.J.1041.2026.0381. Chinese labels translated to English. Original figure composition, numerical values, axes, data, error bars and arrows are unchanged. Significance marks follow the p values reported in the Results. Raster source with editable English text and documented significance overlays.
